grammar.title: How's...?  问候 / 询问状态
grammar.explain: 用 'How's' (How is 的缩写) 询问情况:How's the weather? How's your mom?

grammar.title: It's + 形容词 描述天气
grammar.explain: 天气句型 'It's' + 形容词:It's sunny / cold / hot / windy

quiz.q: What do you say when it's not raining and the sun is out?
How do you ask about today's weather?

listening.audio: It's a beautiful day. The sky is blue and the sun is bright. Let's go to the park. Don't forget your hat!

reading.note: It's = It is, 描述天气

output.prompt: Describe today's weather in 2-3 sentences. Mention the temperature and what to wear.
output.cn: 用 2-3 句话描述今天的天气。提到温度和应该穿什么。
output.sample: Today is sunny and hot. The sky is blue. I should wear a hat and shorts outside.

grammar.title: 现在进行时 It's + V-ing
grammar.explain: 正在发生的动作用 'It's + 动词 ing':It's raining (正在下雨)

grammar.title: Where + be 动词 询问位置
grammar.explain: 'Where is...?' 询问东西在哪

quiz.q: If 'It's raining outside', what should you take?
Where is the umbrella in the lesson?
How do you ask 'where is my umbrella' in English?

listening.audio: Mom, it's raining outside! Take your umbrella. Where is my umbrella? It's by the door. Thanks, Mom!

output.prompt: It's raining outside. Write 3 sentences about what you do and need.
output.cn: 外面在下雨,写 3 句话:你做什么,需要什么。
output.sample: It's raining outside. I take my umbrella and put on my coat. I stay inside and read a book.

grammar.title: What time is it? 询问时间
grammar.explain: 标准问时间用 'What time is it?' 回答用 'It's + 时间'

examples.en: What time is it? It's 5 o'clock.
What time is it? It's noon.

grammar.title: before / after 介词
grammar.explain: before 在...之前;after 在...之后,后接名词或时间

quiz.q: How do you ask the time?

listening.audio: Dad, what time is it? It's three o'clock. When can I watch cartoons? After your homework. OK! Two more hours!

output.prompt: Tell about your morning. What time do you do things?
output.cn: 讲讲你的早上。你几点做什么事?
output.sample: I wake up at 7 o'clock. I eat breakfast at 7:30. I go to school at 8 o'clock.

grammar.title: What day is + 时间?
grammar.explain: 问'什么日子'用 'What day is today/tomorrow/Friday?'

grammar.title: favorite 表示最喜爱
grammar.explain: 'my favorite + 名词' 表示我最喜爱的某事物

quiz.q: How do you ask what day it is?

listening.audio: Mom, what day is today? It's Saturday! No school today! Yay! Can we go swimming? Sure, after breakfast!

fillBlanks.sentence: On ___, we don't go to school.

output.prompt: What's your favorite day of the week and why? Write 2-3 sentences.
output.cn: 你最爱周几?为什么?写 2-3 句话。
output.sample: Saturday is my favorite day. There's no school. I play with my friends and watch cartoons.

grammar.title: should + 动词原形
grammar.explain: 'I should...' 表示应该做某事:What should I wear? 我应该穿什么?

grammar.title: 形容词 + 名词 描述衣服
grammar.explain: 颜色 / 状态 形容词放名词前:red sweater 红毛衣

quiz.q: If it's cold, what should you wear?

listening.audio: Mom, what should I wear today? It's cold outside. Wear your red sweater and blue jeans. And warm socks too! Thanks Mom! I feel cozy now.

output.prompt: Describe what you're wearing today. Include 2-3 items and colors.
output.cn: 描述你今天穿什么。包括 2-3 件衣物和颜色。
output.sample: Today I'm wearing a blue t-shirt and black jeans. I have white socks and red shoes. I feel comfortable.

expressions.en: I have many toys on the floor.

grammar.title: There is/are + 名词 描述存在
grammar.explain: 'There is + 单数 / There are + 复数' 表示某处有

grammar.title: 介词 on / in / under 表位置
grammar.explain: on 在...上面 / in 在...里面 / under 在...下面

options: Lots of toys on the ground

listening.audio: Welcome to my room, Jake! Wow, your room is so cool! That's my new bookshelf. And so many toys on the floor! Let's play with the cars!

fillBlanks.sentence: There ___ a bed in my room.

reading.en: My bed is by the window.

output.prompt: Describe your room. What's in it? What's your favorite thing?
output.cn: 描述你的房间。里面有什么?你最喜欢什么?
output.sample: My room is small but cozy. There's a bed, a desk, and a bookshelf. My favorite thing is my teddy bear.

expressions.en: What do you like to do?
I play the piano every day.

grammar.title: What do you like to + V?
grammar.explain: 询问喜欢做什么:What do you like to do? 你喜欢做什么?

examples.en: What do you like to eat?
What do you like to play?

grammar.title: every day 频率副词
grammar.explain: every day 每天,放句末:I read every day.

quiz.q: How often does the speaker play piano?

listening.audio: What do you like to do after school? I love drawing pictures. And you? I play the piano every day. Wow, that's amazing! Is it hard? A little, but very fun!

output.prompt: What's your hobby? How often do you do it? Write 2-3 sentences.
output.cn: 你的爱好是什么?多久做一次?写 2-3 句话。
output.sample: My hobby is reading books. I read every night before bed. I love stories about animals.

grammar.title: Want to + V 表达意愿
grammar.explain: 'Want to + 动词' = 想做某事:Want to play? = 想玩吗?

grammar.title: I'll = I will + V 未来动作
grammar.explain: 'I'll + 动词' 表示 '我将要做某事'

quiz.q: In soccer, what do you do with the ball?
If 'just us two' play, how many players?

listening.audio: Hey Tom! Want to play soccer? Yes! I love soccer! How many players? Just us two. We can take turns. Cool! I'll kick first!

output.prompt: What sport do you like? How do you play it? Write 2-3 sentences.
output.cn: 你喜欢什么运动?怎么玩?写 2-3 句话。
output.sample: I love soccer. I play with my friends on Saturdays. We kick the ball and try to score goals.

grammar.title: What does + 人 + do? 问职业
grammar.explain: 用 'What does she/he do?' 问她 / 他做什么(职业)

grammar.title: She/He is a + 职业
grammar.explain: 回答职业用 'She is a + 职业' 或 'He is a + 职业'

quiz.q: Who makes food in a restaurant?

listening.audio: Mei, what does your mom do? She's a doctor. She helps sick people. That's amazing! What about your dad? He's a teacher. He teaches math.

reading.en: I want to be a chef.

output.prompt: What does your mom or dad do? Write 2-3 sentences about their job.
output.cn: 你妈妈或爸爸做什么?写 2-3 句他们的工作。
output.sample: My mom is a nurse. She works at a hospital. She helps doctors and takes care of sick people.

grammar.title: Does + 主语 + V? 一般疑问句
grammar.explain: 'Does + 单数主语 + 动词原形 + ?' 问是否做某事

examples.en: Does this bus go to school?

grammar.title: How much is it? 问价钱
grammar.explain: 问价格用 'How much is...?' 回答用 'It's + 金额'

quiz.q: How do you ask the price?

listening.audio: Excuse me, does this bus go downtown? Yes! Get on. It's two dollars. Here you go. How long is the ride? About fifteen minutes. Sit anywhere!

reading.en: I take the bus to school.

output.prompt: Tell about a time you took the bus or another vehicle. Where did you go?
output.cn: 讲讲一次你坐公交或其他车的经历。去了哪里?
output.sample: Last weekend I took the bus with my mom. We went to the city center. The ride was about 20 minutes.

grammar.title: It's me 自我介绍电话
grammar.explain: 打电话时识别自己用 'It's me' 或 'This is + 名字'

grammar.title: miss someone 想念某人
grammar.explain: 'I miss + 人' 表示想念某人

quiz.q: On the phone, how do you say it's you?

options: See you in the future on Sunday

listening.audio: Hello, Grandma! It's me, Lily. Hi sweetie! How are you? I'm great! I miss you so much. See you on Sunday? Yes! I love you, Grandma!

output.prompt: Call a family member you miss. Write what you say.
output.cn: 给一个你想念的家人打电话。写你说的话。
output.sample: Hi Grandma! It's me. I miss you. How are you? See you next weekend! I love you!

grammar.title: What's wrong? 询问问题
grammar.explain: 用 'What's wrong?' 关心地问别人怎么了

grammar.title: My + 身体部位 + hurts
grammar.explain: 描述身体某处疼:My + 身体部位 + hurts

quiz.q: If you have a cold, what should you do?

listening.audio: Hello! What's wrong, my friend? My head hurts and I'm tired. Open your mouth. Say 'Ah'. Ahhh. You have a cold. Drink lots of water.

output.prompt: Imagine you're sick. Tell the doctor what's wrong in 2-3 sentences.
output.cn: 想象你病了。用 2-3 句告诉医生哪里不舒服。
output.sample: Hello, doctor. My throat hurts. I have a cold. Can you help me?

expressions.en: Yes! You can wash the apples.

grammar.title: Can I + V? 礼貌请求
grammar.explain: 'Can I help?' 礼貌问能不能做某事

grammar.title: How many + 复数名词?
grammar.explain: 'How many + 复数名词?' 问数量

quiz.q: If you want to help, what do you say?
How do you ask the quantity?

listening.audio: Mom, can I help you today? Yes! You can wash the apples. How many apples should I wash? Five, please. I love helping you!

output.prompt: How do you help at home? Write 2-3 sentences about chores you do.
output.cn: 你在家怎么帮忙?写 2-3 句你做的家务。
output.sample: I help my mom in the kitchen. I wash dishes after dinner. I also clean my room every weekend.

grammar.title: Do you have + 名词?
grammar.explain: 问别人是否有某物或某人:Do you have any brothers?

grammar.title: How old is + 主语? 问年龄
grammar.explain: 问 'How old' + be 动词 + 主语

quiz.q: How do you ask about siblings?

listening.audio: Do you have any brothers? Yes, I have a little brother. How old is he? He's three years old. He's so funny! I want to meet him!

reading.en: My sister is older than me.

output.prompt: Tell about your siblings (or being only child). Write 2-3 sentences.
output.cn: 讲讲你的兄弟姐妹(或独生子女)。写 2-3 句。
output.sample: I have one sister. She is six years old. She is funny and we play together every day.

grammar.title: What's in + 容器? 问内容
grammar.explain: 'What's in your bag?' = 你包里有什么?

grammar.title: It smells + 形容词
grammar.explain: 感官动词 smell + 形容词:It smells good 闻着香

listening.audio: What's in your lunch box today? Sandwich and an apple. You? Rice and chicken. It smells good! Want to share? Let's trade!

output.prompt: Describe your favorite lunch. What's in it?
output.cn: 描述你最爱的午餐。里面有什么?
output.sample: My favorite lunch is fried rice. It has chicken, eggs, and vegetables. My mom makes the best fried rice!

grammar.title: Happy + 节日 / 事件 祝福
grammar.explain: 'Happy + 名词' 祝福某人:Happy birthday / Happy New Year

grammar.title: Make a + 名词 做某事
grammar.explain: make a wish 许愿 / make a cake 做蛋糕

listening.audio: Happy birthday, Mei! Here's your cake! Wow! Chocolate! My favorite! Make a wish, sweetie! OK. Now I'll blow! Happy birthday to you!

output.prompt: Describe your last birthday or favorite birthday. Write 2-3 sentences.
output.cn: 描述你上次或最爱的生日。写 2-3 句。
output.sample: My last birthday was great. I had a chocolate cake. My friends came over and we played games all day.

expressions.en: I want to be a giraffe!

grammar.title: What do + 复数主语 + V?
grammar.explain: 问复数主语做什么:'What do giraffes eat?' = 长颈鹿吃什么?

grammar.title: 比较级 the tallest
grammar.explain: 'the + 最高级' 表示最...:the tallest animals

options: A tall animal with a long neck

quiz.q: Where do you see many animals together?

listening.audio: Look, Dad! A giraffe! It's so tall! Yes! Giraffes are the tallest animals. What do they eat? They eat leaves from tall trees. Cool!

output.prompt: What's your favorite zoo animal? Why? Write 2-3 sentences.
output.cn: 你最爱什么动物园的动物?为什么?写 2-3 句。
output.sample: My favorite zoo animal is the panda. Pandas are cute and fluffy. They eat bamboo and they are great climbers.

expressions.en: Can I come over to see her?

grammar.title: Do you have + 名词? 问有无
grammar.explain: 问别人是否拥有:'Do you have a pet?'

grammar.title: Her/His name is + 名字
grammar.explain: 她 / 他的名字叫:Her name is...

options: A small animal with long ears

quiz.q: If 'Her name is Snowy', the pet is:

listening.audio: I heard you have a new pet! Yes! A white rabbit named Snowy. Aww, what does she eat? She loves carrots and lettuce. Can I come see her?

output.prompt: Do you have a pet (or want one)? Describe it in 2-3 sentences.
output.cn: 你有宠物吗(或想要)?用 2-3 句描述它。
output.sample: I have a brown dog named Buddy. He loves to play with balls. We go for walks every day.

grammar.title: What is + 计算式?
grammar.explain: 数学问题用 'What is X + Y?' 问答案

grammar.title: 数字 + plus + 数字 = 数字
grammar.explain: 数学加法表达:'X plus Y is Z' / 'X + Y = Z'

listening.audio: Class, what is two plus three? Me! I know! It's five! Great job, Sam! Now try four plus six. Four plus six is ten! Wonderful! You are a math star!

output.prompt: Make 2 simple math problems and answer them. Write in English.
output.cn: 出 2 道简单数学题并用英语回答。
output.sample: What is 3 plus 4? Three plus four is seven. What is 8 minus 2? Eight minus two is six.

grammar.title: I'll = I will + V 表示将来
grammar.explain: 'I'll draw' = 我将要画(将来动作)

grammar.title: I'm + V-ing 正在做
grammar.explain: 现在进行时:'I'm drawing' = 我正在画

listening.audio: Today we'll draw your favorite animal. I'll draw a big purple cat! I'm drawing a green dog! Wow, so creative! Look! My purple cat is finished!

output.prompt: Describe a picture you would draw. What colors and shapes?
output.cn: 描述一幅你想画的画。用什么颜色和形状?
output.sample: I would draw a big yellow sun. The sky would be blue with white clouds. There would be a green tree and a small house.

grammar.title: How much is + 单数?
grammar.explain: 问不可数物品或单数物品价格用 'How much is + 名词?'

grammar.title: I'll take it 决定购买
grammar.explain: 店里决定买:'I'll take it' = 我要这个

quiz.q: How do you ask the price?

listening.audio: How much is this toy? It's five dollars. That's a good price. I'll take it! OK, here's your toy. And here's your change. Thank you!

output.prompt: Describe shopping for a toy. What was the price? Did you buy it?
output.cn: 描述买玩具。多少钱?你买了吗?
output.sample: Yesterday I went shopping with mom. I saw a cute teddy bear. It cost ten dollars. I bought it!

grammar.title: I'd like... 礼貌请求
grammar.explain: 'I'd like' = I would like = 我想要(礼貌)

grammar.title: Anything else? 还要别的吗?
grammar.explain: 服务员常问 'Anything else?' 确认还要什么

quiz.q: If asked 'Anything else?' and you don't want more:
Where do you usually buy snacks?

listening.audio: Hi! I'd like a snack, please. What kind? Some chocolate cookies. Anything else? Yes, also a juice. Anything else? No, that's all. Thanks!

output.prompt: Order your favorite snack at a store. Write the dialogue (3-4 sentences).
output.cn: 在店里点你最爱的零食。写对话(3-4 句)。
output.sample: Hi! I'd like some chocolate, please. What kind? Dark chocolate. Anything else? Yes, a small juice. Thanks!

grammar.title: The + 复数主语 + are + V-ing
grammar.explain: 现在进行时复数:The flowers are blooming

grammar.title: 形容词 and 形容词
grammar.explain: 用 'and' 连接两个形容词:warm and sunny

quiz.q: If the weather is 'warm and sunny':

listening.audio: Look! Spring is here! The flowers are blooming everywhere. The birds are singing in the trees. It's warm and sunny. Let's go play outside!

output.prompt: What's your favorite spring activity? Write 2-3 sentences.
output.cn: 你最爱春天什么活动?写 2-3 句。
output.sample: My favorite spring activity is flying kites. I go to the park with my dad. We watch our kites in the blue sky.

grammar.title: 颜色 + and + 颜色 + and + 颜色
grammar.explain: 列举多个颜色:red, yellow, and orange(最后一个前加 and)

grammar.title: Let's + V 一起做某事
grammar.explain: 'Let's' = Let us,提议一起做

quiz.q: What colors are autumn leaves usually?

listening.audio: Look at the autumn leaves! They're red, yellow, and orange. The leaves are falling slowly. Let's collect some pretty ones for our art project!

output.prompt: Describe autumn where you live. Use colors and what you do.
output.cn: 描述你住的地方的秋天。用颜色和你做什么。
output.sample: Autumn in my city is beautiful. The trees are orange and red. I love to walk in the park and collect leaves.

grammar.title: She/He has + 名词 描述外貌
grammar.explain: 用 has + 名词描述别人的外貌:She has long hair

grammar.title: looks + 形容词
grammar.explain: 'looks + 形容词' = 看起来...:She looks happy

quiz.q: If 'She has long hair', her hair is:

listening.audio: Look at that girl over there! She has long brown hair and big eyes. She's wearing a pretty pink dress. She looks happy! She is dancing!

output.prompt: Describe a friend or family member's appearance. Use 3 details.
output.cn: 描述朋友或家人的外貌。用 3 个细节。
output.sample: My sister has long black hair. She has bright brown eyes. Today she's wearing a yellow shirt.

grammar.title: It has + 数字 + 名词
grammar.explain: 描述事物有多少:It has seven colors / four legs

grammar.title: 复数主语 + are + 形容词
grammar.explain: 'Rainbows are magical' 复数主语用 are

quiz.q: How many colors in a rainbow?
Which is NOT a rainbow color?

listening.audio: Look at the rainbow! It has seven beautiful colors. Red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, and purple! Rainbows are magical. They come after the rain.

output.prompt: What's your favorite color? Why? Write 2-3 sentences.
output.cn: 你最爱什么颜色?为什么?写 2-3 句。
output.sample: My favorite color is blue. It reminds me of the sky and the ocean. I have a blue shirt and a blue backpack.

expressions.en: Cheer up! Everything will be OK.

grammar.title: How do you feel? 问感受
grammar.explain: 用 'How do you feel?' 问别人感受,回答用 'I feel + 形容词'

examples.en: How do you feel? I feel great.

grammar.title: Why + be 动词 + 主语?
grammar.explain: 问原因:Why are you sad? = 你为什么难过?

quiz.q: If you get a gift, you usually feel:
How do you ask about feelings?

listening.audio: How do you feel today? I feel happy! Why are you happy? It's my birthday! Wow, congratulations! Why are you sad? I miss my friend. Cheer up!

output.prompt: Tell about a time you felt very happy or very sad. What happened?
output.cn: 讲一次你很开心或很难过的经历。发生了什么?
output.sample: Last week I felt very happy. My friend came to visit me. We played all day and ate lots of snacks. It was great!

grammar.title: Can you + V? 问能力
grammar.explain: 'Can you + 动词原形?' 问别人能否做某事

grammar.title: 数字单位 ten / twenty / hundred
grammar.explain: 10 ten / 20 twenty / 30 thirty / 100 one hundred

listening.audio: Can you count to 100? Sure! Ten, twenty, thirty, forty, fifty, sixty, seventy, eighty, ninety, one hundred! Great counting!

output.prompt: How high can you count? Write the numbers from 10 to 100 by tens.
output.cn: 你能数到几?写从 10 到 100 的十的倍数。
output.sample: I can count by tens: ten, twenty, thirty, forty, fifty, sixty, seventy, eighty, ninety, one hundred!

grammar.title: Merry / Happy + 节日
grammar.explain: 'Merry Christmas' / 'Happy New Year' 节日祝福

grammar.title: This is for you 这是给你的
grammar.explain: 送礼物时说 'This is for you'

quiz.q: If someone gives you a gift, you say:

listening.audio: Merry Christmas! This is for you. Wow, thank you so much! Open it and see! It's a cool toy car! I love it!

output.prompt: Describe your favorite holiday. What do you do? Write 2-3 sentences.
output.cn: 描述你最爱的节日。你做什么?写 2-3 句。
output.sample: My favorite holiday is Christmas. We have a big tree with lights. Santa brings me gifts and my family eats a special dinner together.

expressions.en: May you have a great year!

grammar.title: May you + V 祝愿表达
grammar.explain: 'May you + 动词' 表示祝愿:May you have a great year!

grammar.title: Here's = Here is 这是
grammar.explain: 'Here's + 单数名词' 给某物时说

quiz.q: What's special about Chinese New Year?
If someone gives you a red envelope, you say:

listening.audio: Happy Chinese New Year, Grandma! Happy New Year, sweetie! Here's a red envelope for you. Thank you so much, Grandma! I love you! May you have a great year!

output.prompt: Tell about Chinese New Year traditions. What do you do?
output.cn: 讲讲春节传统。你做什么?
output.sample: On Chinese New Year, my family has a big dinner. We eat dumplings together. Grandma gives me a red envelope with lucky money.
